name: Grappling Hook
notes: HoH1 stops at 4 levels. HoH2 ships an unused Rogue Grappling Hook (players/rogue/skills/rog_grappling_hook.sval: a teleport and a minor stun), which the ported Thief uses.
summary: Fire a grappling hook and pull yourself to where it lands, stunning enemies there. You have 100% evasion while you fly.
